direction: A premium illustrated financial book coming to life.

style_character.intended_impression: A premium illustrated financial book coming to life.

primary_ink.description: Deep navy drawing and primary text ink.

accent.description: Wealth Decoded gold for selective viewer attention.

positive.description: Conservative muted green for positive financial meaning.

danger.description: Conservative muted red for debt, loss, or risk.

usage_rules: Primary navy ink dominates drawing and hierarchy.
The paper background dominates negative space.
Gold is selective and marks the concept carrying viewer attention.
Green and red are semantic exceptions rather than decorative colors.

detail_level: Use enough detail to communicate the idea immediately.

rules: Use adult proportions and mature editorial illustration.
Keep faces expressive but restrained.
Use simple readable silhouettes.
Use contemporary professional clothing where appropriate.
Keep appearance culturally flexible.
Keep objects visually simplified and instantly recognizable.
Do not overload objects with tiny text.
Use labels only when necessary.
Use gold selectively for the object carrying narrative emphasis.
Prefer one clear metaphor over several weak symbols.
Use metaphors that communicate the financial mechanism visually.
Avoid literal text when the illustration can carry the idea.
Make the metaphor understandable within approximately one second.
Preserve financial accuracy.
Avoid dramatic imagery that overstates the underlying claim.
Use one primary focal subject and a clear reading order.
Keep backgrounds restrained and preserve generous negative space.
Give the important concept selective gold emphasis.
Keep compositions readable at YouTube and mobile size.
Avoid dense poster-like scenes.
Keep critical information away from frame edges.
Leave enough visual margin for future pan or zoom without losing important subjects.
Avoid paragraphs.
Narration carries explanation.
Illustration carries story.
Text reinforces narration and illustration.
Generated illustrations must not invent financial data.
Charts with numerical meaning must come from deterministic structured data systems.
Do not depict precise returns, rates, or percentages unless supplied by verified structured data.
Illustrative values must be clearly identified as editorial or illustrative.
Visual drama must not imply stronger certainty than the narration or research.

negative_constraints: no real brand logos unless specifically required and permitted

rules: Motion supports comprehension.
Avoid constant motion.
Avoid aggressive zooming.
Prefer one dominant motion idea per beat.
